description_ru: Аллювиальные отложения. Пойма и первая надпойменная терраса. Пески, суглинки, галечники
note: GGK-200/1 Q-41-XIII (Inta), Severo-Uralskaya series, Quaternary map 1st ed. 1963 (printed 1971), RASTER (geokniga 4464, JPG 3084x4776, 200 dpi, ~25 m/px) ; fill = map tint (legend swatch #abca97); 1st-edition print: map tints differ from the swatches (lpIV hatch, glIII2 hatch), so fills of the main units are map tints (k-means centres of the 5x5-median face, checked against labelled polygons); the Usa river prints in the lpIV tint (0-2 dE) and the large lakes are 17.6 dE from lpIV, so no WATER row (both read as lpIV); lalIII1 restricted to the SE and m-glmI-II to the W edge strip (--restrict): elsewhere their tints match dark valley linework
